# Hugging Face Public Archive

Corresponding Datawhale public dataset repository:

- [Datawhale/atec2026-task-b-reproducibility](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Datawhale/atec2026-task-b-reproducibility)

## Content Boundaries

HF archiving is consistent with the GitHub tutorial, saving lightweight documents, configurations, inspection scripts, result boundaries, and publicly inspected large files. It does not include:

- External dataset without re-distribution permission.
- Private checkpoints, uncleaned private logs, and unauthorized raw competition videos.
- Access tokens, machine absolute paths, and internal service addresses.

Two additional types of material that can be reproduced publicly have been uploaded:

- `source/ATEC2026_Simulation_Challenge_20260518.zip`: The source code, robot assets, and baseline snapshot from the official public repository on 2026-05-18, with the official MIT LICENSE retained.
- `TaskB-B2Piper/videos/` and `TaskB-B2Piper/frames/`: Local Task B debugging/assessment previews, both marked as debug-only, and do not represent official scores or successful grasping.

Source snapshot SHA-256: `84ccfdc3903e4e03a5de8a7dedd90314b15ed09382c136bbeee6a858dae802d9`.

All uploaded large files are listed separately in the HF directory with their source, version, and SHA-256 values; they are not included in the standard Git history on GitHub. For the complete lists of uploads and local deletions, see [. For instructions on GitHub archive reconciliation and local cleanup, see ](https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied/blob/main/15-Challenge%E7%AB%9E%E8%B5%9B/ATEC2026/docs/05_%E5%BD%92%E6%A1%A3%E5%AF%B9%E8%B4%A6%E4%B8%8E%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E6%B8%85%E7%90%86.md).

## Reproduction from GitHub

```bash
git clone https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied.git
cd every-embodied/15-Challenge竞赛/ATEC2026/TaskB-B2Piper
bash code/scan_public_release.sh .
python3 code/build_public_manifest.py . --output public_manifest.json
```

## Obtained from HF

```bash
git clone https://huggingface.co/datasets/Datawhale/atec2026-task-b-reproducibility
```

The tutorial files in the HF repository are not a substitute for the official Task B environment. Please install the environment from the official repository first, and then use this directory for boundary auditing and experimental records.

## Reproduction Capability Boundaries

After uploading, the public archive can reproduction the observation auditing, publishing scanning, official source code snapshot location, and video evidence reading in the tutorial; a complete Task B simulation still requires locally installing Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, GPU drivers, and a Python environment that match the official version. The HF archive does not include private environment caches, and it does not claim that simulation can be started unconditionally only using `git clone`.

It is recommended to use the official source code version: `4000378a9a6fc6ce3e57bcdd20a1582f6854e0dc`. If using this HF snapshot, please follow the `readme.md`, `LICENSE`, and task scripts in the compressed package.

## Other public competition details

To prevent local data from being scattered, the HF root directory also archives:

- `official_docs/`: ATEC2026 official online competition player guide and update instructions. No local paths, credentials, or personal email addresses were found during content inspection.
- `historical_task_e/`: The XSA plugin package and training configuration for Task E. These are historical experimental data, not the Task B policy, and do not represent a stable scoring strategy.

These materials are separate from the Task B topic code. Readers should not directly regard the fixed Piper manipulation scheme for Task E as the B2-Piper garbage collection controller.
